capabilities: Render indented pseudocode as line-numbered blocks
Color and bold keywords by type
Group related algorithms into class blocks
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer (desktop or mobile). No network access; the clipboard is only written by the link command, never read. Optional beta versions install via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to present pseudocode as a formatted, line-numbered algorithm block without resorting to LaTeX or images.

relations.evidence: Snippets expand a short trigger into a longer line with values to fill in, as in LaTeX Suite.

summary: Renders plain indented pseudocode as a centered, line-numbered block with colored keywords, indentation guides, and right-aligned comments.
